ice-signal.$description: Ice Signal — Verified badges, link text, outlined button borders, focus rings, and filter pills — the only chromatic accent on a monochrome canvas, cool enough to read as informational rather than promotional

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Primary text, icon strokes, hairline borders, and checkbox fills — the dominant surface signal against the near-black canvas

fog.$description: Fog — Muted secondary text, placeholder copy, and subtle borders — the bridge tone between paper white and the dark surfaces

iron.$description: Iron — Outlined button borders and tertiary dividers on the main canvas — the lightest neutral that still reads as a structural edge

slate.$description: Slate — Hover-state surface wash on icons and small controls, lightest elevated background in the stack

graphite.$description: Graphite — Navigation rail, footer, and elevated panel backgrounds — one step above the page surface

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Page canvas and card surface — the dominant background under all content

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Top navigation bar and footer base — the deepest layer of the surface stack

void.$description: Void — Body backdrop, outer page shell, and deepest shadow zone behind the nav

gtamerica.$description: Primary UI typeface — body copy, labels, nav items, buttons, and section headings from 12px through 32px, weight 500 reserved for labels and emphasized links, weight 400 for body and headings

gtamericamono.$description: Monospaced data typeface — ETH/USDC floor prices, token counts, contract-style strings, and any numeric value that must align column-to-column
